text: maya: Heads-up: noticed several anchors are failing on the migrated docs site when a heading follows an image or blockquote. Example: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/guide#deploy-steps doesn't jump. jonathan: Probably slugify differences after the MDX migration. Can you paste the failing markdown snippet? maya: Sure, here's the snippet from /guide/ops.md that breaks for me: ```markdown > Note: this example assumes local creds are loaded ![diagram](./assets/flow.png) ### Deploy steps 1. Build 2. Ship ``` rachel: I can repro locally with mkdocs build. The generated id for the h3 becomes `deploy-steps-1` sometimes. I think we now dedupe slugs differently when an image or blockquote precedes a heading. sam: CI linkcheck is failing on the main branch with this: ``` [linkcheck] ERROR: Fragment not found: https://docs.redwood.ai/guide#deploy-steps (status: 200) [docusaurus-build] ERROR in plugin-content-docs: anchor not found for marker "#deploy-steps" ``` liam: Proposed short-term plan: 1) update broken cross-page links to the deduped slug where necessary, or add explicit HTML anchors in the target page; 2) add a note to the migration guide about slug changes for headings after media; 3) follow up with a tooling fix in our slugify step. maya: I prefer minimal churn — add an explicit anchor immediately after the image to restore link behaviour, then fix links. Eg: ```html ### Deploy steps ``` This should be safe and quick. docs-bot: Deploy preview for branch fix/docs-anchor-escape available: https://deploy-preview-1123--staging.docs.redwood.ai/guide (build 1123) :white_check_mark: rachel: I pushed branch fix/docs-anchor-escape with the anchor snippet and updated two links. Can someone review? @liam @jonathan jonathan: I'll take a look in ~30m. Also can you add a short entry to docs/migration/MDX-HEADING-SLUGS.md saying: "headings after media may get dedupe suffixes; add explicit anchors when linking from elsewhere" liam: I'll open the PR and assign reviewers. I'll also run linkcheck locally using: `npm run linkcheck -- --verbose` and post results here. If CI is green we can merge the quick fix and then schedule the slugify/tooling follow-up. maya: :thumbsup: Thanks all. After merge let's run a site-wide linkcheck job and surface any other pages with the same pattern so we don't get another surprise later.
